lines: AH! Penni, you have to stop me!
I didn't think that would happen. I thought I was just wearing it out...
...It was a fish. Just like me.
I didn't mean to. I didn't even notice how hard I was hitting it.
Please... if I get carried away again, call me back before it's too late.

choices.text: I will. I'm sorry I let it go that far.
We'll be more careful from now on.

lines: I know you didn't mean to, either...
I just wish we'd stopped sooner.
...Please. I don't want to see that happen again.
I wanted to help you, Penni... not do this.
